category: consumer/SMB cloud drive with protocol access

egress.terms: Not published as a volume on the pricing page. Protocol access (SFTP, WebDAV, SMB, rsync, SCP, Git) is tier-gated: 'Im Business Essential und Standard Tarif sind die Zugriffsmöglichkeiten WebDAV und SMB inklusive. Wenn Sie sich den Advanced oder Premium Tarif gesichert haben, sind alle genannten Zugriffsmöglichkeiten inklusive.' — i.e. rsync/SCP/SFTP may require the higher tier.

interface_detail: WebDAV, SMB (lower tiers); + SFTP/SCP/rsync/Git (Advanced/Premium). rclone hidrive backend exists
limits_note: Protocol access gated by tier. 20-user cap. Ends up 4.5× Hetzner per TB at the 10 TB tier.
reliability_note: STRATO is the German consumer-grade option; Wave-6 had flagged the 1 TB annual promo as 'trial-only, closed 2026-02-15' — the Business ladder below is the steady-state paid product, not that promo.

evidence.proved: 1 TB €17.50/mo, 3 TB €30/mo, 5 TB €55/mo, 10 TB €90/mo, setup €0.00, up to 20 users; promo rows 'danach 12,50 €/Mon.' (1TB), 'danach 25 €/Mon.' (3TB), 'danach 50 €/Mon.' (5TB), 'danach 85 €/Mon.' (10TB)
consumer ladder Starter 500 GB €6, Basic 1 TB €7.50, Plus 2 TB €12.50, Family 2 TB €17.50
protocol tier-gating clause and 'Zugriffsmöglichkeiten sind SFTP, WebDAV, SMB, rsync, SCP und Git' quoted verbatim

price_per_tb_month: 10 TB €90 ÷ 10 = €9.00/TB/mo. 5 TB €55 ÷ 5 = €11.00/TB. 3 TB €30 ÷ 3 = €10.00/TB. 1 TB €17.50/TB. ≈$10.44/TB at best. 4.4× Hetzner BX41 for the same capacity.
